name: tilldone-desktop
description: Four-layer Electron client for TillDone over Pi RPC

scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts --target node --format cjs --external electron --outfile dist/main.cjs && bun build src/preload.ts --target node --format cjs --external electron --outfile dist/preload.cjs && bun build renderer/renderer.ts --target browser --outfile dist/renderer.js
scripts.test:smoke: bun run build && bun test/smoke.ts && bun test/api-smoke.ts
